description: Removal of rear balcony, sub-basement stair and erection of a single storey rear extension and insertion of a rooflight at first floor level and internal alterations
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No above ground works shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces, of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Planning, Heritage and Design and Access Statement, 26HT_PLN_E01, Unnumbered Location Plan, Unnumbered Block Plan, 26HT_PLN_P01: Received 08/07/2019. 
Environment Agency Flood Risk Matrix, Flood risk addendum submitted with Householder EA flood risk assessment matrix: Received 07/09/2019. 
26HT_PLN_P01: Received 11/09/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No above ground works shall take place until 1:20 scale drawings of the first floor rear window, product specifications to demonstrate the window would be single glazed and a material sample have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Works shall be carried out in accordance with the agreed details.
Condition : 5 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
